description: Alerts within a radius of a latitude and longitude in a city, nearest first, each with its distance in miles: live ones (bucket now, ongoing or ahead) and ones that ended in the last 12 hours (bucket recap, so 'was there anything here this afternoon' can be answered). Default radius 3 miles, max 25. Use when the person names a place, an address or 'near me' and you have coordinates. It does not geocode: resolve the address to lat and lon first.

category.description: Only this category: road, transit, weather, power, water, construction, emergency, film, sanitation, government_notice. Omit for all.
